feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Unlocking the Blood-Brain Barrier: Can Low-Intensity Focused Ultrasound Enable Effective Delivery of Anti-Amyloid and Anti-Tau Antibodies in Alzheimer's Disease?
drug.zh: 低强度聚焦超声有望突破血脑屏障，提升抗淀粉样蛋白和抗tau抗体在阿尔茨海默病中的递送效率。

drug.title: Clinical Practice Outcomes With Lecanemab for Alzheimer Disease.
drug.zh: 真实世界用lecanemab的早期AD患者中，ARIA发生率与严重不良事件及12个月认知变化如何。

drug.title: From Proof of Principle to Therapeutic Discipline: Strategies to Improve the Benefit/Risk Profile of Amyloid-Targeting Treatments for Alzheimer's Disease.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样蛋白治疗已证实可延缓早期阿尔茨海默病进展，但获益风险比窄，需优化策略。

drug.title: Anti-Amyloid Antibodies in the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease: An Umbrella Review.
drug.zh: Lecanemab与donanemab可延缓认知衰退并清除β淀粉样蛋白，但ARIA风险需权衡。

drug.title: APOE-stratified genome-wide association analyses provide insights into the genetic etiology of Alzheimers's disease.
drug.zh: 按APOE基因型分层的大型全基因组关联分析，揭示了各亚型特异的AD遗传风险位点与机制。

drug.title: The path to treating multiple-etiology dementia: Combining vascular risk control and disease-modifying neurodegenerative therapies.
drug.journal: Neurotherapeutics : the journal of the A
drug.zh: 多病因痴呆需血管危险控制与抗淀粉样蛋白等神经退行性疗法联合，单通路治疗模式已不足。

drug.title: Baseline plasma C1q and C3 as potential biomarkers for lecanemab efficacy and ARIA risk in early Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 基线血浆C1q和C3可预测早期阿尔茨海默病中lecanemab的疗效及ARIA风险。

mech.title: The Alzheimer's disease risk gene SORL1 is a regulator of excitatory neuronal function.
mech.zh: SORL1缺失通过改变突触蛋白互作与AMPA受体定位，损害兴奋性神经元功能。

mech.title: The Diagnostic Role of FDG-PET in Dementias Presenting with Language and Behavioral Symptom.
mech.zh: FDG-PET代谢模式可区分以语言障碍起病的AD与FTLD谱系，并与脑脊液生物标志物对应。

mech.title: Changes in serum β-synuclein precede blood biomarkers of Alzheimer pathology in Down syndrome.
mech.zh: 唐氏综合征成人血清β-突触核蛋白升高早于AD血液病理标志物约二十年，或可预警突触功能障碍。

mech.title: Unmasking preclinical Alzheimer's pathology: auditory distraction cost and occupational reserve jointly discriminate amyloid positivity in subjective cognitive decline.
mech.zh: 噪声下视觉记忆的听觉分心代价结合职业认知储备，可识别主观认知下降中的淀粉样蛋白阳性者。

mech.title: Do amyloid trajectories reach a ceiling? Evidence from iterative approximation and simulation.
mech.zh: ADNI数据经SILA拟合未显示淀粉样蛋白沉积存在生理上限，提示其累积轨迹可能并非S型平台。

mech.title: T1 mapping in Alzheimer's disease: a quantitative MRI study with amyloid-PET correlation.
mech.zh: AD患者海马qT1升高且与淀粉样蛋白负荷相关，提示其可作为AD微结构改变的MRI生物标志物。

mech.title: Integrating network pharmacology and experimental validation to uncover the mechanisms of Ganoderma lucidum in ameliorating neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease.
mech.journal: The Journal of pharmacy and pharmacology
mech.zh: 灵芝提取物经STAT1/STAT3/JAK2/TNF通路抑制神经炎症，改善Aβ1-42诱导AD小鼠认知功能。

mech.title: Genetic evidence suggests a protective role of immunoglobulin M in Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 遗传学证据表明IgM升高与阿尔茨海默病风险降低相关，而IgG和IgA无此保护关联。

dx.title: A Harmonized Visual Reading Framework for Tau PET Staging in Alzheimer Disease.
dx.zh: 跨示踪剂五级tau PET视觉判读框架可一致分期阿尔茨海默病tau负荷并识别早期与不典型病例。

dx.title: T1 mapping in Alzheimer's disease: a quantitative MRI study with amyloid-PET correlation.
dx.zh: AD患者海马qT1升高且与淀粉样蛋白负荷相关，提示其可作为AD微结构改变的影像标志物。

dx.title: Lysosomal Expression Profile in Plasma Associates with Disease Severity in Parkinson's Disease.
dx.zh: 血浆溶酶体蛋白谱可区分帕金森病并关联病情严重度，线粒体蛋白则无此关联。

dx.title: Glial and Vascular Plasma Biomarkers Across the Alzheimer's Disease Continuum: An ADNI-Based Longitudinal Study.
dx.zh: 血浆GFAP与sTREM2随AD病程递增，而血管标志物呈不同轨迹，支持神经血管单元多细胞机制。

dx.title: A multimodal model for clinically defined MCI integrating plasma biomarkers and brain microstructural features: a dual-cohort external validation study.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217联合白质微结构特征可跨队列区分临床定义的MCI与正常认知。

dx.title: A scalable workflow using digital cognitive assessment and pTau217 for MCI detection.
dx.zh: 数字认知评估前置可将pTau217检测阳性率提升至约三倍，实现低患病率人群的可扩展MCI筛查。

dx.title: Rethinking tau-targeted therapy in Alzheimer's disease: Toward a dual biomarker strategy.
dx.zh: 可溶性p-tau下降未必反映tau靶向治疗获益，需结合p-tau262等特定位点与神经纤维缠结负荷的双生物标志物策略评估。

dx.title: Validation of plasma core biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease: A multicenter study in usual practice conditions.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217及p-tau217/Aβ42在真实临床条件下诊断AD的效能优于其他核心标志物。

prev.title: Bilingualism modulates baseline brain-cognition relationships in aging: Evidence from the HABS-HD cohort.
prev.zh: 双语并未改变老年人大脑结构基线或纵向变化，但调节了脑结构与认知的关系。

prev.title: Real-world neuropsychiatric safety profile of foslevodopa/foscarbidopa infusion in advanced Parkinson's disease.
prev.zh: 真实世界中氟左旋多巴/氟卡比多巴输注治疗晚期帕金森病，神经精神不良事件风险与既往认知障碍、幻觉及冲动控制障碍密切相关。

prev.title: Firearm safety and suicide prevention in older adults: a primary care clinical framework.
prev.zh: 美国老年枪支持有者自杀风险最高，本文提出初级保健中评估枪械致死风险与安全储存咨询的临床框架。

prev.title: Rationale and Design of the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities Generation 2 (ARIC Gen2) Study.
prev.zh: ARIC Gen2研究通过同步14天连续血糖与心电监测，探索2型糖尿病患者血糖波动如何触发房颤等心律失常。

prev.title: Anti-inflammatory dietary patterns and cognitive aging in older adults: a scoping review of mechanistic, clinical, and nursing implications.
prev.zh: 抗炎饮食或助认知老化，但各膳食模式不可等同，观察性结论尚缺随机试验证实。

prev.title: Plasma biomarker and machine learning modeling of clinical progression in cognitively normal individuals at risk for Alzheimer's disease.
prev.zh: 基线血浆标志物结合机器学习可预测认知正常者未来向MCI或AD的临床进展。

prev.title: Genetic evidence suggests a protective role of immunoglobulin M in Alzheimer's disease.
prev.zh: 遗传学证据表明IgM升高与阿尔茨海默病风险降低相关，而IgG和IgA无此保护关联。

prev.title: Learning age-conditioned brain atlases via free-prototype modeling for brain age prediction.
prev.zh: 提出自由原型框架，在潜空间直接学习年龄条件化脑图谱，提升脑龄预测的可解释性。

intro.title: Unlocking the Potential of Isatin Scaffolds in Acetylcholinesterase Inhibition.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲一种叫靛红的小分子可能帮阿尔茨海默病等患者保住大脑里一种关键信号，普通人可把它当作未来新药的候选方向。

intro.title: A new era of genome-wide association studies in the field of Alzheimer's disease and overlapping co-pathologies: lessons learned from a neuropathology-centered approach.
intro.zh: 这篇综述说，查基因找阿尔茨海默病病因时，光靠看病症容易出错，得结合大脑解剖结果才更准，帮我们更早找到真正有用的药。

intro.title: Caenorhabditis elegans as a Model for Studying Nrf2/SKN-1 Activation in Alzheimer's Disease: Plant Bioactive Compounds and Therapeutic Translation.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是：科学家用一种叫秀丽隐杆线虫的小虫子，研究某些植物里的天然成分能不能激活人体自身的抗氧化开关，从而帮我们对抗老年痴呆。

intro.title: More efficient screening for preclinical Alzheimer's clinical trials using mixture of experts.
intro.zh: 验血就能提前挑出可能得阿尔茨海默病的人，帮新药试验更快找到合适对象，少做贵检查。

intro.title: The Crosstalk Between Diabetes and Alzheimer's Disease: A Molecular Perspective.
intro.zh: 糖尿病和老年痴呆可能是一根藤上的两个瓜，控好血糖或许能帮大脑少受伤害。

intro.title: Anti-amyloid treatment in Alzheimer disease: updated implications for patients with cerebral amyloid angiopathy and other cerebrovascular conditions.
intro.zh: 治早期阿尔茨海默病的新药虽能清脑内淀粉样蛋白，但可能让脑血管变脆、引发脑水肿或微出血，这篇综述提醒医生和患者用药前要评估脑血管风险。

intro.title: Human Stem Cell-Derived Models of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimmune System.
intro.zh: 科学家用人的干细胞在培养皿里造出迷你脑模型，专门研究大脑里的“保安细胞”怎么闹脾气引发老年痴呆，帮我们找新药。

intro.title: Overview in Electrochemical and Electrical Biosensors for Determining Blood Protein Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是抽血查阿尔茨海默病的新方法，比腰穿和脑扫描更便宜、更方便，有望让普通人早筛查早发现。
